sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy outlines Humana’s billing requirements and reimbursement for a short inpatient hospital stay .

sections.heading: Oklahoma Medicaid Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. An inpatient claim billed for a short inpatient hospital stay is subject to review to determine the medical necessity of an inpatient level of care, based on Humana’s Short Inpatient Hospital Stay medical coverage policy, available in the References section of this policy. Humana requires the provider to submit medical records, when requested, for a short inpatient hospital stay. Humana may deny the claim if medical records are not received upon request. If Humana determines that medical necessity for the inpatient level of care was not met, according to Humana’s Short Inpatient Hospital Stay medical coverage policy, Humana denies the inpatient claim. Humana will accept an outpatient claim for the short inpatient hospital stay and will allow the provider to submit all service codes ordinarily appropriate for an outpatient level of care.

sections.heading: Definitions of Italicized Terms
content: • Short inpatient hospital stay : A hospital stay of fewer than 48 hours.
